title: "How to run **UMIs analysis** in the computational infrastructure of INAB"
execute:
  echo: false
---

## Steps to run the analysis:

### 1. Log in to the appropriate server:

o 160.40.71.62, 160.40.71.64, 160.40.71.78

### 2. Identify where your NGS results (.fastq files) are located:

o e.g., /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2025_05_21_ERIC_study

### 3. Move to the your working directory:

``` bash
cd /work/folder_of_each_user
```

### 4. Create a new analysis directory:

``` bash
mkdir UMIs_analysis_20261104
```

### 5. Move to the your new analysis directory:

``` bash
cd /work/folder_of_each_user/UMIs_analysis_20261104
```
### 6. Create a SampleList

You have to **update** with the right path to your **fastq files**.

``` bash
ls –la /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2022-08-09-TP53_Diagnosis/ | awk '{print $9}' | awk -F "_R" '{print $1}' | sort | uniq > SampleList
```

### 7. Remove samples that should not be analyzed:

``` bash
nano SampleList
```

In order to **edit** the SampleList use the following:

o `Delete button`: Removes one letter

o `Ctrl + k`: Removes a whole row

o `Ctrl + o and Enter`: Saves the modified SampleList

o `Ctrl + x`: Exits and returns to the terminal


### 9. Update the runAnalysisTemplateUMIs.sh template

``` bash
nano runAnalysisTemplateUMIs.sh
```

### 10.	Apply changes based on the following instructions

o	Update pathToFASTQFiles variable with the right path to your fastq files (DO NOT FORGET TO PLACE "/" AT THE END!!!!!):

``` bash
pathToFASTQFiles="/mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2022-08-09-TP53_Diagnosis/"
```



### 10. After the analysis is completed

Move your folder from **/work** to **/mnt/new_home**

``` bash
cd ..
```

``` bash
rsync -r UMIs_analysis_20261104 /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research
```
